title: The Rhythm of Riddles
subtitle: A Winter Mystery in Calcutta’s Shadows
summary: As Byomkesh delves into government secrets in Cuttack, his companion returns to a quiet, uneventful Calcutta—until a mysterious neighbor’s visit disrupts the monotony. A chance encounter in their three-storied building soon entangles them in a web of intrigue, promising that even the most ordinary evenings can hide extraordinary riddles. Discover a tale where every knock on the door could be the start of a new enigma.
